messages.content: How can I sell my acoustic guitar?

function.name: tune_instrument
function.description: This function helps tune instruments based on the instrument type and the desired key or note. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

instrument_type.description: The type of the instrument, e.g. 'acoustic guitar', 'piano'.

key.description: The key or note to which the instrument should be tuned to. Default is 'Standard' for guitars.

message.content:
Here’s a step‑by‑step guide to help you get your acoustic guitar sold quickly and safely: | Step | What to Do | Why It Matters | |------|------------|----------------| | **1. Inspect & Clean** | Give the guitar a thorough cleaning—wipe down the body, neck, and strings. Check for cracks, loose hardware, or other damage. | A clean, well‑maintained instrument looks more appealing and shows you’ve cared for it. | | **2. Determine Condition** | Decide whether it’s “like new,” “good,” “fair,” or “needs repair.” | Accurate descriptions build trust and reduce disputes later. | | **3. Research Pricing** | Look up similar models on eBay, Reverb, Craigslist, Facebook Marketplace, and local classifieds. Note how long listings stay active. | Helps set a realistic asking price that attracts buyers but still gives you value. | | **4. Take Quality Photos** | Capture multiple angles: front, back, side, headstock, bridge, and any unique features or flaws. Use natural light and a neutral background. | Good photos are the first thing buyers notice; they can make or break a sale. | | **5. Write a Clear Description** | Include brand, model, year, serial number, condition notes, and any accessories (case, strap, picks). Mention why you’re selling. | Transparency reduces questions and builds buyer confidence. | | **6. Choose Your Platform(s)** | • **Local** – Craigslist, Facebook Marketplace, Nextdoor, local music forums.
• **Online** – eBay, Reverb, Etsy (if vintage), or specialized guitar marketplaces.
• **Trade‑in** – Local music shops or national chains sometimes offer store credit. | Different platforms reach different audiences; listing on multiple sites maximizes exposure. | | **7. Set Up Payment & Shipping** | • For local sales, cash or Venmo/PayPal Cash App is common.
• For online, use PayPal Goods & Services, Venmo, or direct bank transfer.
• If shipping, calculate cost, package securely (guitar case + foam), and insure if valuable. | Secure payment methods protect against fraud; insurance covers loss/damage. | | **8. Meet Safely (for local)** | • Pick a public place (coffee shop, library, police station).
• Bring a friend or family member if possible.
• Verify the buyer’s ID before handing over the instrument. | Personal safety is paramount when meeting strangers. | | **9. Negotiate Smartly** | • Be prepared to explain your price and any concessions (e.g., including a case).
• Keep the conversation polite and professional. | Negotiation skills can increase your final sale price while keeping the process smooth. | | **10. Finalize the Sale** | • Sign a simple bill of sale (many free templates online).
• Transfer ownership paperwork if required (some states require a signed serial number release). | Documentation protects both parties legally. | ### Quick Tips - **Timing:** Listings posted mid‑week often get more views than weekend posts. - **Safety:** Never accept a check from an unknown buyer; always verify funds before handing over the guitar. - **Shipping:** If you ship, use a trackable service (UPS Ground, USPS Priority) and keep the receipt. - **Return Policy:** Consider offering a short return window (e.g., 48 hrs) for local buyers who may want to test play. ### Optional Extras - **Tune Before Listing:** A freshly tuned guitar feels more inviting. You can use a tuner app or a physical tuner to ensure it’s in standard tuning (E‑A‑D‑G‑B‑E). - **Professional Inspection:** If you suspect hidden issues, have a luthier inspect it. A certified condition report can justify a higher price. Follow this checklist, and you’ll be well‑prepared to attract serious buyers, secure a fair price, and complete the transaction safely. Happy selling!
message.reasoning: The user asks "How can I sell my acoustic guitar?" They want advice. We need to respond with instructions. No tool usage needed. Just give them steps: evaluate condition, price research, choose platform (eBay, Craigslist, Facebook Marketplace, local classifieds), take good photos, write description, list, negotiate, meet safely, payment method. Also mention shipping options if online. Also mention potential trade-in at music stores. Provide safety tips. Possibly mention using a tuning tool? But not necessary. So just answer.
